fix: plan_backdrops runs every frame that has a Backdrop batch and allocates these containers fresh each time. Keep them as scratch fields on WgpuRenderer (cleared with clear() at entry, capacity kept), or at minimum pre-size plans and capturers with Vec::with_capacity(batches.len()) and the maps with capacity equal to the backdrop count. Also consider returning plans into a reused renderer-owned Vec so the caller stops allocating it per frame.

glyph_page_generations builds a new HashMap every frame that draws both a backdrop and glyphs. Store the page-generation list in a renderer-owned scratch Vec<(u16, Option<u64>)> that is cleared and refilled (deduplicating by linear scan, since page counts are small), or resolve generations lazily inside hash_backdrop_source under the already-held lock instead of pre-collecting them.

Replace the per-frame HashSet with a scratch buffer on the renderer, or with a Vec<LayerId> filled and then sorted/deduped (plans are few), reused across frames via clear(). Membership is only queried with needed.contains(&layer) on a handful of layers.

Replace String with a typed error enum for capture failures (for example CaptureError { Unsupported, SizeOverflow, Timeout, MapFailed(String), ... } implementing Display and std::error::Error), return Option<Result<CapturedFrame, CaptureError>>, and record the migration in the CHANGELOG under a **Breaking (incular-wgpu):** entry. Only if the public API is not already governed by API_DESIGN.md; otherwise leave it.
